translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Naglqlzku Yawe!
Nangr-ngrbzku bade nabz kxmrna.
Naglqlzku nide mz nzyrlwrpx-krm leplz nedeng mz Mangr-nzangiongr nide.
Nigu lr Israel na-abrtzlvzku Yawe mz nzngini-krde Kxrpalz.
X nigu lr Jerusalem naelalz-ngrm drtwrgu King rgu.
Naelabzku bade
Mz nzrta-krgu kcte x nzayrni-krgu gita.
Murde Yawe abrtz-zlwz-ngrde nigu leplz nedeng,
X aovxiole enqmi rgung mz nzmnc-xgle-krgu nide.
Delc nigu kxnztrng nabilvzku nzaovxio-krgu.
X nangr-abrtzku mz nrlckxbq krlzbzle mz nrlckxngrlx.
Naogu namalqlvzlr Gct.
X narmaleku toki r vea mz mqgu.
Murde na-ayzlubzku da mz lr mrkzbleng,
Mz nzatutr-krgu nzaryplapxkr Gct leplz lcng.
X nape-amqngiku king rdrng,
Badr kxnzrmailz rdrng amrlx mz nzaovxio-krgu nidr.
Mz nzamatqkr Gct nigu, rlr-ngrmle bagu, nigu leplz nedeng,
Nzprtr-krgu mz nzatutr-krde natqde mz nzayrplapx-krgu lr mrkzbleng.
Naglqlzku Yawe!
